model.purpose: Detector run on every live frame (manifest: frontend/public/models/efficientdet_lite0.manifest.json).
model.ref: Fastest model that runs on phones without a GPU: 4.6 MB, 25.69 COCO val AP (TFLite Model Maker table); measured 29 ms/image on desktop CPU (docs/benchmarks/detector_eval_coco128.json).

letterbox.purpose: Pad each frame to a square (grey 114) before detection instead of letting MediaPipe stretch it to the 320x320 input.
letterbox.ref: coco128: letterboxed AP 37.0 / AP50 56.9 vs stretched AP 36.3 / AP50 54.6.

maxFps.purpose: Upper bound on detector frames per second (user-selectable in Instrument settings).
maxFps.ref: Measured 75-110 ms per frame for the CPU (WASM) delegate in headless Chromium; 10 fps keeps the main thread free on phones.

grabWidth.purpose: Width of camera frames transferred to the vision worker; the detector input is 320x320 so larger frames only cost copying.

model.purpose: Selective, more accurate detector (manifest: frontend/public/models/yolox_s.manifest.json). Never runs on every frame.
model.ref: coco128: AP 48.3 vs 37.0 and small-object AP 21.3 vs 5.0 for the fast detector; 40.5 COCO val mAP per the YOLOX README; Apache-2.0.

mode.purpose: auto = load on first use (Image Debug, Deep Scan, video keyframes, live ambiguity checks); off = never download it.
mode.ref: Model (35.9 MB) + ONNX Runtime WebAssembly (28.3 MB) are only fetched when needed.

backend.purpose: ONNX Runtime Web execution provider. auto = WebGPU if available and verified on a probe image, else WebAssembly.
backend.ref: onnxruntime-web README: WebGPU needs Chromium 113+, described as experimental; WebAssembly is the portable fallback.

wasmThreads.purpose: ONNX Runtime WebAssembly threads (only effective when the page is cross-origin isolated; otherwise 1).
wasmThreads.ref: onnxruntime-web wasm-factory.ts requires SharedArrayBuffer / crossOriginIsolated for >1 thread.

liveCooldownMs.purpose: Minimum time between automatic deep checks during Live Scan.
liveCooldownMs.ref: Deep checks are a verification aid, not a tracker; one per ~12 s keeps CPU/battery use low.

liveMaxLatencyMs.purpose: Automatic deep checks during Live Scan only run if the measured deep inference latency on this device is below this value.
liveMaxLatencyMs.ref: About six fast-detector frames at 10 fps; slower devices keep deep detection for Image Debug and Deep Scan only.

videoBudgetMs.purpose: Total time budget for deep detection on video keyframes; stops early on slow devices.
videoBudgetMs.ref: Keeps Video Debug responsive; keyframes beyond the budget keep fast-detector results only.

aiFrameMaxEdge.purpose: Long edge of live frames sent to the optional AI reasoning layer (re-downscaled server-side).
aiFrameMaxEdge.ref: Backend normalises to 1024 px for live frames anyway; 1280 leaves room for the resize.

aiFrameQuality.purpose: JPEG quality of live frames sent to the AI layer.
aiFrameQuality.ref: Visually lossless for scene reasoning at ~100-200 KB per frame.

deepScanMaxEdge.purpose: Long edge of the frozen frame captured for Deep Scan.
deepScanMaxEdge.ref: Matches the backend's deep-analysis image size.

deepScanQuality.purpose: JPEG quality of the Deep Scan frame.
deepScanQuality.ref: Higher than live frames because Deep Scan is a one-off.

keyframeMaxEdge.purpose: Long edge of video keyframes sent to the AI layer.
keyframeMaxEdge.ref: Same as live AI frames after server normalisation.

thumbWidth.purpose: Width of the thumbnail used for motion, sharpness, brightness and scene fingerprints.
thumbWidth.ref: Cheap to compute every frame; enough resolution for frame differencing.

gridWidth.purpose: Luminance-grid columns of the scene fingerprint.
gridWidth.ref: Coarse layout descriptor in the spirit of histogram/grid shot-boundary detectors.

gridHeight.purpose: Luminance-grid rows of the scene fingerprint.

histogramBins.purpose: RGB histogram resolution of the scene fingerprint (4x4x4 = 64 bins).
histogramBins.ref: Colour-histogram differences are the classic shot-boundary cue.

histogramWeight.purpose: Weight of the histogram term in the fingerprint distance (the grid term gets 1 - weight).
histogramWeight.ref: Histogram is robust to small camera motion; the grid catches layout changes with similar colours.

gridGain.purpose: Scale of the mean absolute grid difference before clipping to 1.
gridGain.ref: Maps a 0.33 mean luminance change to the maximum distance.

motionGain.purpose: Scale of the mean absolute luminance difference between consecutive frames (motion = min(1, gain * meanDiff)).
motionGain.ref: A hand moving through ~15% of the view reaches ~1.

motionPixelDelta.purpose: Per-pixel luminance change counted as 'changed' for the motion bounding box.
motionPixelDelta.ref: Above camera sensor noise in indoor light.

motionMinFraction.purpose: Minimum share of changed pixels before a motion box is reported.

sharpnessLogOffset.ref: Variance of the Laplacian focus measure (Pech-Pacheco et al., ICPR 2000); log scale chosen after the raw value saturated on test images.

sharpnessLogSpan.purpose: Span of the log10 Laplacian variance mapped onto 0-1.
